name: Best Additions
description: The best new pitch for each pitcher, from what their comps actually throw.
explanation: Comps spin the fastball like this pitcher. Expected Stuff+ is the median of the comps' real Stuff+ on that pitch, not a model of a made-up pitch.
Listed only when at least a fifth of the comps throw the pitch (so it fits this kind of arm) and confidence is Medium or High.
